rationale: The inspected text of EASA NPA 2025-07(B) directly supports the claim components: DS.AI.150 and associated AMC1/AMC2/GM1 cover operational domain/ODD, system development assurance, configuration and life-cycle data, and supervised-ML learning assurance (recognising ED-324/ARP6983), while DS.AI.160 and AMC1 AI.160(a) address continuous risk assessment and in-service monitoring. The claim preserves the exact status and scope of the source as a proposed framework rather than an adopted decision or certified application.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002, PDF pp. 24–26 (DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150, AMC2 AI.150)
S-CHAL-002, PDF pp. 31–33 (GM1 AI.150, DS.AI.160, AMC1 AI.160(a))
limitations: EASA NPA 2025-07(B) is a Notice of Proposed Amendment containing proposed DS.AI material; it is not an adopted EASA decision or final AMC/GM.
Inspection is bounded to the excerpted PDF regions covering DS.AI.150 and DS.AI.160.
